text:
nora: Quick thread  marketplace private-offer for VertexWorks. Need a commit floor to avoid tiny commit churn. Proposal: min commit $25k + volume tiers (25k, 100k, 400k). Also add a 90-day early-renew credit of 6% if they renew into a higher tier.

ben: min commit makes sense. Question: should we surface the min commit in listing or hide it behind 'contact sales'? Hiding reduces friction but causes expectation mismatch.

frida: Recommend show min commit on listing as 'Minimum commitment required' — transparency helps self-serve. Add small tooltip copy: "commitment needed to qualify for partner discounts".

samir: Ops/billing: implement credits as billing adjustments tagged `credit:early_renew` + `offer:vertex-pvt`. Avoid new SKUs; we'll apply negative line items. Also cap credit at $40k.

nora: Good. Sales asks: include a pre-renew checklist in collateral so AEs can push to qualify upsell before 90 days.

ben: Also we should include an anti-gaming line: credits void if usage manipulation detected. Legal to draft.

frida: I'll draft listing copy and AE checklist. Keep messaging short: "Tiered committed discounts. Minimum commitment: $25k. Early-renew credit up to 6%."

samir: I'll open billing PR with sample event schema and cap param today. Example: `{\"event_type\":\"credit_adjust\",\"cust\":\"C456\",\"offer\":\"VERTEX-PVT-2026\",\"tag\":\"early_renew\",\"amount_usd\":6000,\"cap_usd\":40000}`

nora: Action items: Frida: listing + AE checklist; Samir: billing PR; Ben: coordinate legal. If all green, plan go-live next Tuesday.

announce-bot: Calendar event created: VertexWorks private-offer final review  1798765600. Invitees: nora, ben, frida, samir.

ben: LGTM on timing.

frida: Will share drafts by EOD.
